scheme_name: CSIR-NAL Technology Transfer for Aerospace MSMEs
overview: CSIR-NAL Technology Transfer for Aerospace MSMEs is a program under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research - National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL) aimed at transferring aerospace technologies developed by CSIR-NAL to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in the aerospace sector. The scheme supports technology commercialization, industry collaboration, and innovation by enabling MSMEs to access CSIR-NAL's patented technologies, technical expertise, and R&D facilities. It focuses on strengthening the aerospace MSME ecosystem through technology licensing, joint development, and incubation support.
objectives: Transfer CSIR-NAL developed aerospace technologies to MSMEs for commercialization
Promote industry-academia collaboration in aerospace R&D
Support MSMEs in scaling up indigenous aerospace innovations
Enhance technology absorption and adoption in the aerospace MSME sector
Facilitate joint development and co-creation of aerospace solutions
Provide access to CSIR-NAL's testing facilities and technical expertise
Strengthen India's self-reliance (Atmanirbharta) in aerospace technologies
eligibility: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) engaged in aerospace, aviation, or allied sectors, with valid Udyam registration, capable of absorbing and commercializing transferred technologies, and meeting technical and financial criteria as defined in the technology transfer agreement.
benefits: Access to CSIR-NAL's patented aerospace technologies, technical know-how, and R&D facilities; support for prototype development and testing; assistance in regulatory compliance and certification; opportunities for joint development projects; incubation and mentorship support; potential for revenue sharing or licensing agreements; and enhanced market readiness through technology validation.
financial_support: Financial support is structured on a case-by-case basis through technology transfer agreements, which may include upfront licensing fees, royalty-based models, or joint investment mechanisms. Specific quantum or standardized financial assistance is not detailed in the evidence; support is negotiated based on the technology, scope, and commercialization plan.
application_process: 1. Identify relevant CSIR-NAL technology for transfer via the CSIR-NAL technology portfolio or outreach. 2. Express interest through CSIR-NAL's Business Development or Industry Incubation division. 3. Submit a formal application detailing the MSME's profile, intended use, and commercialization plan. 4. Undergo technical and commercial evaluation by CSIR-NAL experts. 5. Negotiate and sign a technology transfer agreement (TTA) outlining terms, royalties, and milestones. 6. Access technology documentation, know-how, and facility support as per agreement. 7. Proceed with prototype development, testing, and scaling under CSIR-NAL guidance.
required_documents: Undertaking on Confidentiality and IP Compliance
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research - National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL)
caveats: Technology transfer is subject to evaluation of technical feasibility and commercial viability
Intellectual property rights remain with CSIR-NAL unless otherwise agreed
MSMEs must comply with confidentiality, quality, and regulatory standards
Support is contingent on availability of technology and CSIR-NAL's capacity
No guaranteed financial grant; terms are negotiated per case
